name: Python
about: What Python is: colours, comments, what a .py file is, and how to debug one

debuggers.name: debugpy
debuggers.see: debugpy goes in the environment this project uses: `python -m pip install debugpy`, with that environment's python. To attach: run debug-attach, say which port to listen on, then start your program with `python -m debugpy --connect PORT your_program.py` — textfold listens and the program connects to it.
